entities.title: Required documents for business visa application
entities.summary: Detailed list of required documents for applying for a Schengen business visa to Germany, covering passport requirements, invitation letters, financial evidence, and other supporting documentation. Emphasizes that incomplete applications may be rejected and processing only begins once fully submitted.
eligibility: Passport valid for at least three months after end of desired visa
Passport must be signed by holder
Multiple entry visa of longer duration only considered if passport has long additional validity
required_documents: Current passport and copies of all previous passports and visas
Two biometric passport photos (not older than six months)
Health insurance policy (minimum cover €30,000, covering all Schengen countries)
Invitation letter and supporting documents from company/organisation in Germany (not older than 3 months)
Hotel bookings for whole duration of stay
Business reference letter from company in Pakistan
Disclosure of all previous visa refusals
List of relatives living abroad (signed original)
application_process: Fill out application on Videx online application system, print and sign
Compile all required documents in correct order and A4 format
Submit complete application; processing begins only once submitted in full
Visa Section may request additional documents at any time
important_notes: Applications missing any required document can be immediately rejected
Unsigned passports are invalid under Pakistani law and cannot receive a visa
Failure to disclose previous visa refusals constitutes fraud and is automatic grounds for refusal
If a previous passport was lost, a police report with English or German translation must be provided

min_income_threshold.notes: Applicant must provide personal and company financial evidence; requirements depend on individual financial resources and company standing

trade_fair_visitors_extra_docs: entrance tickets or fair organiser confirmation
